description: Spaarndammerbuurt (BAG 1933), Houtrijkstraat 399-401 and Polanenstraat 240-242: the 15.4 m end fronts of the 1933 ladder-light rows, five axes (wide, small, staircase, small, wide) on four storeys, the staircase axis right of the middle; a 0.5 m glass-block ladder light from the door canopy to under the eaves over a single portiek door; on the ground a wide window, a small one, the door and a long window under the last two axes; a deep white flat-roof overhang

overhang.note: the row's deep flat-roof overhang: wall top 12.45 m (Houtrijkstraat 381 strip), a white ribbed soffit and a 0.4 m white fascia; chimney stacks stand on the roof behind

door-right.note: a single portiek door on the staircase axis under a white slab canopy (rectified 80.0-80.8 m on Houtrijkstraat 399)

match.note: the 15.4 m five-axis end fronts of the 1933 ladder-light rows; the 12.6 m three-axis fronts are spaarndammer-1933-stair-ladder

rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: wide + small + door + long window | 1-3: wide, small, ladder light, small, wide
rhythm.symmetry: the staircase axis right of the middle; mirrored where the door stands left of it
rhythm.groundFloor: single portiek door under a white slab canopy, a long window beside it
rhythm.roofline: deep white flat-roof overhang along the row
